d: used in a shop to say you don't need help
ex: Can I help you? "No thanks, I'm just looking."
exTr: Yardımcı olabilir miyim? "Hayır teşekkürler, sadece bakıyorum."
exAr: هل يمكنني مساعدتك؟ "لا شكرًا، أنا أتفرج فقط."

ex: This jacket is nice. How much is it?

d: is it possible to pay with a bank card?
ex: Can I pay by card, or is it cash only?
exTr: Kartla ödeyebilir miyim, yoksa sadece nakit mi?
exAr: هل يمكنني الدفع بالبطاقة، أم نقدًا فقط؟

d: used to say the extra money is for the other person
ex: Here's twenty. Keep the change.

d: used in a restaurant to ask what you must pay
ex: Excuse me, the bill, please.
Put your wallet away. It's on me.

d: will you eat here or take the food away?
ex: A coffee, please. "For here or to go?"
exTr: Bir kahve, lütfen. "Burada mı, paket mi?"

d: used to order food or drink
ex: I'll have the soup and a glass of water.
exTr: Çorba ve bir bardak su alayım.

ex: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
Sorry, could you say that again more slowly?
exTr: Pardon, bunu daha yavaş tekrar söyler misiniz?
exAr: عفوًا، هل يمكنك تكرار ذلك ببطء أكثر؟

d: what are the letters of the word?
ex: My name is Siobhan. "How do you spell that?"

d: used to ask the meaning of a word
ex: What does "reluctant" mean?

# w: how do you say ... in English
d: used to ask for a word in English
ex: How do you say "çay" in English?

d: I didn't hear or understand what you said
ex: Sorry, I didn't catch that. What time?
exAr: عفوًا، لم أسمع ذلك جيدًا. في أي ساعة؟

ex: What do you do? "I'm a nurse."

d: what country or city do you come from?
ex: Where are you from originally?

d: used on the phone to ask for someone
ex: Hello, can I speak to Mr Brown, please?
exTr: Merhaba, Bay Brown ile görüşebilir miyim lütfen?
exAr: مرحبًا، هل يمكنني التحدث إلى السيد براون من فضلك؟

ex: Please hold the line. I'll put you through.
exAr: ابقَ على الخط من فضلك. سأحوّلك.

ex: I'm driving. I'll call you back in an hour.
exTr: Araba kullanıyorum. Seni bir saat sonra ararım.
exAr: أنا أقود. سأعاود الاتصال بك بعد ساعة.

d: used on the phone when the person is not there
ex: She's not in? Can I leave a message?
exTr: Burada değil mi? Mesaj bırakabilir miyim?
exAr: ليست هنا؟ هل يمكنني ترك رسالة؟

d: used to say why you are phoning
ex: I'm calling about the flat for rent.

d: I am bored and annoyed with
ex: I'm fed up with this rain.
I'm in a good mood today; the sun is shining.
Leave him alone; he's in a bad mood.
Is dinner ready? I'm starving!
exAr: هل العشاء جاهز؟ أكاد أموت جوعًا!

ex: I worked twelve hours. I'm exhausted.
exAr: عملت اثنتي عشرة ساعة. أنا منهك.

ex: Close the window, I'm freezing!
exAr: أغلق النافذة، أنا أتجمد من البرد!

ex: I can't come out tonight. I'm broke.
exAr: لا أستطيع الخروج الليلة. أنا مفلس.

ex: I'm stuck on question five.

d: I have almost no time left
ex: Hurry, I'm running out of time.
I'm not feeling well. I'll stay home today.
exTr: Kendimi iyi hissetmiyorum. Bugün evde kalacağım.
exAr: لست على ما يرام. سأبقى في البيت اليوم.

ex: I've got a headache. Do you have any painkillers?
exTr: Başım ağrıyor. Ağrı kesicin var mı?

d: used to wish an ill person a fast recovery
ex: Sorry you're ill. Get well soon!
Thank you. Have a nice day!
Have fun at the concert!
Here's your pasta. Enjoy your meal!
Atchoo! "Bless you!"

d: used to wish someone a good trip
ex: Safe journey! Text me when you arrive.
Happy birthday! How old are you today?
exTr: Doğum günün kutlu olsun! Bugün kaç yaşına girdin?
exAr: عيد ميلاد سعيد! كم عمرك اليوم؟

ex: In my view, the plan is too expensive.
exAr: من وجهة نظري، الخطة مكلفة جدًا.

ex: I agree with you about the new rules.
It's the best phone. "I'm not so sure."
exTr: En iyi telefon bu. "Pek emin değilim."

d: what you say is partly right
ex: You have a point. It is a long way.
exAr: معك حق في هذا، إنها مسافة طويلة.

ex: Ah, that makes sense now. Thanks!

d: it is not logical or clear
ex: This sentence doesn't make sense.
I see what you mean, but I still disagree.
exTr: Ne demek istediğini anlıyorum ama yine de katılmıyorum.
exAr: أفهم ما تقصده، لكنني ما زلت لا أوافق.

d: used to give one side of an argument
ex: On the one hand, the city is exciting; on the other hand, it's expensive.
exTr: Bir yandan şehir heyecan verici, öte yandan pahalı.
exAr: من ناحية، المدينة مثيرة، ومن ناحية أخرى، هي غالية.

d: used to get time to think before answering
ex: Why is the sky blue? "That's a good question."

d: used when you need a moment to think
ex: Let me think... Yes, I was there on Monday.
exAr: دعني أفكر... نعم، كنت هناك يوم الاثنين.

d: used when looking for the right words
ex: He's... how can I put it... very direct.

# w: what I'm trying to say is
d: used to explain your idea again
ex: What I'm trying to say is that we need help.
exTr: Söylemeye çalıştığım şu: yardıma ihtiyacımız var.
exAr: ما أحاول قوله هو أننا نحتاج المساعدة.

ex: Could you do me a favour and water my plants?
exTr: Bana bir iyilik yapıp çiçeklerimi sular mısın?
exAr: هل تسدي لي معروفًا وتسقي نباتاتي؟

d: I will help you later because you helped me
ex: Thanks for the lift. I owe you one.
exTr: Beni bıraktığın için teşekkürler. Sana bir borçluyum.
exAr: شكرًا على التوصيلة. أنا مدين لك.

d: it is not useful enough to do
ex: Don't repair it. It's not worth it.

d: it may work, so try it
ex: The app might help. It's worth a try.
I've never eaten sushi, but I'll give it a try.
exTr: Hiç suşi yemedim ama bir deneyeceğim.
exAr: لم آكل السوشي قط، لكنني سأجرّبه.

d: try as hard as you can
ex: Don't worry about the result. Just do your best.
exTr: Sonucu dert etme. Sadece elinden geleni yap.
exAr: لا تقلق بشأن النتيجة. فقط ابذل قصارى جهدك.

ex: He makes a living as a photographer.
I work from home on Fridays.
If you're late again, you'll get the sack.
exAr: إذا تأخرت مرة أخرى ستُطرد من العمل.

d: not go to work for one day
ex: I'm taking a day off on Friday.
We worked overtime to finish the order.
exTr: Siparişi bitirmek için fazla mesai yaptık.

d: arrange to see a doctor, etc.
ex: I need to make an appointment with the dentist.
exAr: أحتاج إلى حجز موعد مع طبيب الأسنان.

ex: Please fill in this form and sign at the bottom.
exTr: Lütfen bu formu doldurun ve altını imzalayın.
exAr: يرجى ملء هذه الاستمارة والتوقيع في الأسفل.

d: do small jobs like shopping or going to the bank
ex: I spent the morning running errands.
exTr: Sabahı ufak tefek işleri halletmekle geçirdim.

d: buy food and things for the house
ex: I usually do the shopping on Saturday.

d: wash the plates after a meal
ex: You cooked, so I'll do the washing up.
Get ready! We leave in five minutes.
We got lost in the old town.
I get along well with my neighbours.
Get in touch if you're ever in London.
exAr: تواصل معي إذا جئت إلى لندن يومًا.

ex: We lost touch after school.
It's easy to make friends at a language club.
exAr: من السهل تكوين صداقات في نادي اللغة.

ex: Did you have a good time at the party?
exAr: هل قضيت وقتًا ممتعًا في الحفلة؟

ex: Can I have a look at your photos?
exAr: هل يمكنني إلقاء نظرة على صورك؟

ex: Please take a seat. The doctor will see you soon.
exTr: Lütfen oturun. Doktor birazdan sizinle ilgilenecek.

d: use a camera to make a picture
ex: Could you take a photo of us?
Take your time; there's no rush.
Pay attention. This part is important.
The wedding will take place in June.
Her dream of living abroad came true.
exTr: Yurt dışında yaşama hayali gerçek oldu.

d: get on the bus in time
ex: I have to catch the bus at 7:15.
exAr: عليّ أن ألحق بحافلة السابعة والربع.

d: be too late for the bus
ex: Hurry, or we'll miss the bus!

d: take someone somewhere in your car
ex: Can you give me a lift to the station?
exAr: هل يمكنك أن توصلني إلى المحطة؟

d: it is on the route you are taking
ex: I'll drop you off; it's on the way.
How long does it take to get to the airport?
What time does the film start?

d: it is the time for me to do something
ex: It's my turn to pay this time.

d: wait a short time; or used when you notice something
ex: Wait a minute, this isn't my bag!
exTr: Bir dakika, bu benim çantam değil!

d: how surprising that these things happened together
ex: You're from Bursa too? What a coincidence!
exTr: Sen de mi Bursalısın? Ne tesadüf!
exAr: أنت أيضًا من بورصة؟ يا لها من صدفة!

ex: Can you fix the website? "I'm on it."
exAr: هل يمكنك إصلاح الموقع؟ "أنا أتولى الأمر."

d: there is no need to hurry
ex: Send it tomorrow. No rush.

d: I feel or think the same
ex: I'm so tired. "Same here."

d: used to say you are pleased about someone's success
ex: I stopped smoking! "Good for you!"

d: really? (surprise) or used to say something is obvious
ex: I got the job! "No kidding! Well done!"
Twenty euros for a coffee? You must be joking!
exTr: Bir kahveye yirmi avro mu? Şaka yapıyor olmalısın!
exAr: عشرون يورو لفنجان قهوة؟ لا بد أنك تمزح!

ex: I can't come. "Oh, that's a shame."
You didn't study, so it serves you right.

d: don't ask about things that are not yours (rude)
ex: It's private. Mind your own business!
exTr: Bu özel. Sen kendi işine bak!
exAr: هذا أمر خاص. لا تتدخل فيما لا يعنيك!

d: why do it? it is useless
ex: What's the point of cleaning? It'll be messy again tomorrow.
exTr: Temizlemenin ne anlamı var? Yarın yine dağınık olacak.
exAr: ما الفائدة من التنظيف؟ ستعود الفوضى غدًا.

ex: Reading is the best way to learn. "I couldn't agree more."
exTr: Okumak öğrenmenin en iyi yolu. "Kesinlikle katılıyorum."

ex: He's angry? I couldn't care less.
exAr: هو غاضب؟ لا يهمني على الإطلاق.

d: it is not something you should know about
ex: How much I earn is none of your business.

d: I will consider it (often a polite no)
ex: Do you want to join the gym? "I'll think about it."
exAr: هل تريد الاشتراك في النادي؟ "سأفكر في الأمر."

ex: Tell me your plan. I'm all ears.
